name: AudioCraft
tagline: Meta open-source library for local text-to-music and sound effect generation
real_test_summary: Generated a 15-second 32kHz stereo background track using musicgen-small on an RTX 3060 12GB in 9.2s with ~5.4GB VRAM peak.
pros: Supports both text-to-music (MusicGen) and sound effects (AudioGen)
Melody conditioning from reference audio tracks
MIT codebase with local Gradio web demo
cons: Medium 1.5B weights recommend 12GB–16GB VRAM for longer clips
Pretrained weights carry a non-commercial CC-BY-NC 4.0 license
description: PyTorch audio generation framework housing MusicGen and AudioGen models to synthesize royalty-free instrumental tracks, melody-conditioned audio, and sound effects locally.
